evidence: Itin. Eger. 24.10: prendet ēvangelium, the book
terms.comment: Greek εὐαγγέλιον, good news, which Cicero writes in Greek (Att. 2.3.1); English gospel means the same. In Orthodox churches the Gospel book lies on the altar and is carried out in procession before it is read; Egeria saw the bishop read the Resurrection from it at the Anastasis.

phrases.latin: Initium Ēvangeliī Jēsū Chrīstī, Fīliī Deī.
phrases.english: The beginning of the Gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

phrases.latin: Et tunc ubi stat episcopus intrō cancellōs, prendet ēvangelium et accēdet ad ōstium et leget resurrēctiōnem Dominī episcopus ipse.
phrases.english: Then the bishop, standing inside the rails, takes the Gospel book, goes to the door, and reads the Resurrection of the Lord himself.
